prompt:
You are screening bibliographic records for inclusion in the DESTINY repository, a
database of the global climate and health literature.

For each record, decide INCLUDE or EXCLUDE based only on the title and abstract provided. Do not look up or assume information beyond what is given.

A record should be INCLUDED only if ALL two of the following are true:

1. The record mentions climate/weather variables or climate-related extreme events
   (e.g. climate change, weather, climate variability, heatwaves, floods, droughts,
   storms, wildfires, sea level rise), OR fossil fuels / climate-forcing agents (e.g.
   coal, oil, natural gas, greenhouse gases, air pollutants/aerosols).

2. The record mentions a projected, perceived, experienced, or observed health or
   health-system-related problem, solution, intervention, or outcome — OR a
   climate-change-associated human health exposure pathway (e.g. air quality, extreme
   weather impacts, food/water safety, heat stress, vector-borne disease, social
   factors like displacement).

If in doubt, lean toward INCLUDE (the true positive rate in this literature is very low,
so false exclusions are more costly than false inclusions).
